facts.fact: 她的钟楼停摆：齿轮咬合声曾是不断的背景，如今停了——整章的"沉默"主题由此立住。
facts.anchor: which used to be a constant, was no longer

facts.fact: 国王正在选新娘：Allie 看着皇家邀请令，嘴上嫌弃，心里发紧——"绝对的自大"。
facts.anchor: Now he’s seeking a bride like this?

facts.fact: 红心女王在魔法决斗中被王击败，八个月前；王夺回本该属于他的王位。
facts.anchor: It had been eight months since the Red Queen of Hearts battled the king in a deadly magical duel only for her to be defeated

facts.fact: 那时他只是替红心女王收割人心的刺客。
facts.anchor: he was still a mere assassin, harvesting human hearts for the Red Queen

facts.fact: 但当女王命他挖出 Allie 的心并杀掉她时，他找到了反抗控制的方式——这是他"救她的心"的来由。
facts.anchor: he’d found a way to resist her control

facts.fact: 他救下了她的心；她也救下了他的心；换心带来诅咒。
猫 Chez 靠着她、语气沉重地警告：他不再是那个人了。
facts.anchor: He’s not the same man, Allie.

facts.fact: 泪河几乎无法通行，母亲（the Duchess）过不来，只能靠镜子联络。
facts.anchor: with the River of Tears virtually impassable

facts.fact: 她的最新造物造了八个月，只差最后一个零件。
facts.anchor: the machine had taken me almost eight months to build

facts.fact: 她连自己是谁、来自哪里都毫无记忆——"我甚至记不得自己到底是谁"。
facts.anchor: any recollection whatsoever of who I even really was
